title: Local Safety Filters for Networked Systems via Two-Time-Scale Design
summary: Safety filters based on Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide formal guarantees of forward invariance, but are often difficult to implement in networked dynamical systems. This is due to global coupling and communication requirements. This paper develops locally implementable approximations of networked CBF safety filters that require no coordination across subsystems.
